description.value: Davies Park is a nature reserve on Bowen Island, operated by the Bowen Island Municipality. It sits within the Howe Sound region, an area of significant natural beauty accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay. Touring cyclists exploring Bowen Island may pass through or near the park as part of a day trip or island loop.
